title: GeoQuads — Daily
spoiler: Think saints, new towns, Olympic rings and thin air.
help: Find the 4 hidden categories. Each has 4 unique items.

groups.name: Named after a saint
groups.fact: São Paulo takes its name from Saint Paul, whose feast day was the day the city was founded.

groups.name: Name means "new town" or "new castle"
groups.fact: Naples comes from the Greek "Neapolis", meaning "new city".

groups.name: Hosted the Summer Olympics more than once
groups.fact: London was the first city to host the Summer Games three times.

groups.name: Above 2,500 metres
groups.fact: Lhasa sits at about 3,650 m, so there is roughly a third less oxygen than at sea level.
